JUDGMENT:
JUDGMENT
O R D E R       
 CIVIL APPEAL NO.   1760   OF 2008
(Arising out of SLP(C)No. 6531/2007)
        Leave granted.  
        Admittedly in the present case the High Court has not complied with the 
provisions of Sec.100 of Civil Procedure Code while deciding the 
substantial question of law.
        Hence, the impugned judgment is set aside.  The matter is remitted to the 
High Court. Regular Second Appeal No. 4759 of 2001 stands restored to 
the file of the High Court.  High Court is requested to dispose of the appeal 
as expeditiously as possible, preferably, within one year.
        This  appeal is disposed of.
